Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference

Result Codes

This section describes the result codes for the functions discussed in this chapter.
telNoErr
No error.
telBadCAErr
Specified call appearance record could not be found or is invalid.
telBadFunction
Specified message code (msgCode) is invalid.
telBadDNErr
Specified directory number handle could not be found or is invalid.
telBadProcErr
Specified message processor (msgProc) is invalid.
telBadTermErr
Specified telephone record handle could not be found or is invalid.
telNoMemErr
Not enough memory is available.
telPBErr
Bad format for parameter block.
